g.text: 3. Can richer answers replace additional people?
NBA RECORDED RESPONSES | Match the accuracy of ten winner-only respondents on the same 465 games.
Paired whole-wave bootstrap recomputes the target and each crossing; >10 draws are retained.
All three formats were recorded together. At k=10, both richer-method improvement intervals include zero; no established respondent saving.
